Dylan / Vivek — taking first pass on the redlines. High-level positions below; I'll prepare tracked-change language and upload to the Drive link.

1) Publicity / Reference Rights:
- Redwood position: We allow customer identification as a "customer of Redwood Inference" in lists and case studies. We will not use Ellis's logo or trademarked imagery without a separate written license (asset license addendum).
- Approval window: propose 7 business days to review/approve customer quotes/case studies, and 5 business days for one-line reference confirmations (e.g., "Ellis Technology is a Redwood customer"). If no response after the full window, approval is deemed granted.

2) Confidentiality / Government Requests:
- Redwood accepts a limited carveout for compelled disclosures where legally required, subject to (a) prior written notice to the other party where not prohibited by law, and (b) disclosure narrowly tailored to the compelled request. We will not allow broad "regulatory" exceptions that permit mass sharing.

3) Internal escalation & fallback:
- If a customer marks an item "confidential" but Redwood views it as non-confidential under the MSA, we will flag for review with Legal and allow 3 business days for dispute resolution before Redwood may follow the template process.

Vivek — can you confirm the 7/5 day cadence works operationally? If yes, I'll push the tracked MSA + a short wording snippet for the order form.

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Works for marketing — 7 business days is tight but doable for a short quote/case study review if we get the assets and the proposed public copy up front. For logo/asset license: marketing will need a separate Asset License Agreement (ALA) that defines placement, size, color, and approval process. We can draft a short ALA template and keep it off the master MSA to avoid slowing procurement.

Dylan — go ahead and send the counterlanguage to Ellis with the following bullets: 1) Customer ID permitted (website list, case studies) with 7 business day approval for case studies and 5 business day for one-line references, 2) Logo use requires ALA executed separately, 3) Compelled disclosure limited and notice-based. Also propose a clause that if objections are not raised in the review window, the approval is deemed granted.
